# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** 10-11 years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v2 c30 P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033)</sub>
- **Origin:** United States  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v2 c5 P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul has an exceptionally beautiful, delicate face framed by a halo of chestnut curls, with dark blue eyes that match his father's. Though small and slender for his age, he is well-proportioned and eventually begins to grow taller during his time in Avonlea. His countenance is generally grave and meditative, but it lights up radiantly when he smiles.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c15 P1](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0001), [v2 c15 P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), [v2 c15 P27](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0027), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c27 P23](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0023), [v2 c28 P9](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0009)_

## Personality

Paul is a deeply imaginative, sensitive, and poetical boy who populates his world with imaginary friends and elaborate fantasies. He possesses a grave, thoughtful demeanor and an intuitive understanding of others, though he can be quietly resolute when defending his principles. Manly and capable despite his dreamy nature, he enjoys outdoor games and holds his own with other boys. He is exceptionally affectionate toward those he loves, expressing his feelings with frankness and sweet sincerity.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 c15 P4](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0004), [v2 c15 P20](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0020), [v2 c23 P31](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0031), [v2 c27 P20](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0020)_

## History

Paul Irving arrives in Avonlea from the United States to reside with his grandmother, Mrs. Irving, on the shore road. He enters Avonlea school under Anne Shirley, with whom he instantly strikes up a deep, kindred-spirit friendship. Paul invents an elaborate cast of 'rock people'—including Nora, the Golden Lady, and the Twin Sailors—and writes a imaginative composition detailing his imaginary adventures. He excels as a pupil, forming friendships with his classmates and defending his national pride in a draw with St. Clair Donnell. Later, Anne introduces Paul to Miss Lavendar Lewis at Echo Lodge, where Paul forms a warm bond with her and shares his imaginative world. When his father, Stephen Irving, unexpectedly visits Avonlea, Paul introduces him to Anne and later facilitates their reunion with Miss Lavendar. Following the wedding of Stephen Irving and Miss Lavendar at Echo Lodge, Paul prepares to move to Boston with them and Charlotta the Fourth in the autumn.

## Quotes

> Please, teacher, I found these in Mr. Wright's field, and I came back to give them to you because I thought you were the kind of lady that would like them, and because . . . I like you, teacher.  <sub>[v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021)</sub>

> The most interesting people I know are my rock people and I mean to tell you about them. I have never told anybody about them except grandma and father but I would like to have you know about them because you understand things.  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)</sub>

> I knew you wouldn't want to forget your little mother even if you could. . . . You're so good at understanding, teacher. Nobody else understands so well . . . not even grandma, although she's so good to me.  <sub>[v2 c15 P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006)</sub>

> You know, teacher. Isn't it splendid to be that kind, teacher?  <sub>[v2 c15 P19](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0019)</sub>

> I think you would make a splendid mother. You have just the right look in your eyes . . . the look my little mother always had.  <sub>[v2 c27 P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058)</sub>
